## Personality

Mr. Phillips struggles with classroom management and is unable to maintain order among his students. To compensate for this lack of control, he relies frequently on corporal punishment.

_Sources: [v2 IV Different Opinions P7](../source/v02-c04.md#nw-v02-c04-p0007)_

## History

As a local schoolteacher who boarded at Eben Wright's house, Phillips was known for frequently whipping his students and maintaining poor order in his classroom. When [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) teased [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), prompting her to smash her slate over Gilbert's head, Phillips punished [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by making her stand at the blackboard. Later, Phillips publicly disciplined [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for being late by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), an act that drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to temporarily quit attending his school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--phillips.md)

Mr. Phillips serves as Anne's school teacher, though their interactions are marked by conflict and harsh discipline. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) smashes her slate over [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's head for teasing her, Mr. Phillips punishes her by forcing her to stand at the blackboard. His subsequent decision to publicly humiliate [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) leads to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) refusing to return to his school for a time, though she eventually attends until her emotional farewell on his final day of teaching.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), +10 more_

- Mentor of — school teacher  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013)</sub>

### [Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/minnie-andrews--phillips.md)

[Minnie Andrews](../character/minnie-andrews.md) is a pupil in Mr. Phillips's schoolroom. She is present among the classmates who warmly welcome [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) back to the classroom during Mr. Phillips's tenure as teacher, and she remains in his class up through his final day of school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P16](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), +6 more_
